job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Seeking an experienced Senior MLOps / GenAI Engineer with expertise in building, deploying, and managing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role requires strong experience in Vertex AI, MLOps, model deployment, automation, and cloud-native AI platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy ML and Generative AI solutions using Vertex AI.
Build and manage ML pipelines using Vertex Pipelines and Kubeflow.
Develop and optimize training workloads, hyperparameter tuning, and model lifecycle management.
Implement GenAI solutions using Gemini, Agent Builder, Vector Search, and RAG architectures.
Deploy, monitor, and maintain production ML models with drift detection and explainability.
Collaborate with data engineering teams using BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, and Spark.

Automate ML workflows using CI/CD, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and GKE




Preferred candidate profile
